settings.passwordHint: Business mail usually requires a client authorization code

settings.paypalNote: Backup payment channel for overseas customers

intTips.square: Get the token and signature key in Square Developer Console. Save the exact public webhook URL, including tenant and business query parameters.
intTips.shopify: Create a custom app in Shopify Admin > Apps > Develop apps to get the Admin API token.
intTips.stripe: Find keys in Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys. Add the webhook endpoint after saving.
intTips.paypal: Create an app in PayPal Developer Dashboard to get Client ID / Secret.

channelNote.dingtalk: Posts to a DingTalk group via bot webhook.

channelTip.telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather to get the token, chat your bot once, then get your chat_id from https://api.telegram.org/bot[TOKEN]/getUpdates.
channelTip.whatsapp: Create a Business app in Meta for Developers, add WhatsApp, then copy the access token and phone number ID. Use the recipient number in E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567.
channelTip.slack: In Slack, create an app, enable Incoming Webhooks, and copy the webhook URL for your channel.
channelTip.discord: In Discord, open channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks to create a webhook URL.
channelTip.mattermost: In Mattermost, create an incoming webhook (Integrations > Incoming Webhooks) and copy its URL.
channelTip.matrix: Use your Matrix access token (from an Element login) plus the target room ID.
channelTip.feishu: In the Feishu group, add a custom bot and copy its webhook URL.
channelTip.wecom: In the WeCom group, add a group robot and copy its webhook URL.
channelTip.dingtalk: In the DingTalk group, add a custom robot and copy its webhook URL.
